meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 探索代码时会先建立结构地图,而不是从头读整个文件。它会用 smart_search 搜索相关文件和符号,用 smart_outline 查看文件骨架,用 smart_unfold 只展开需要的函数源码,从而节省 token。
howto.when: 当你想理解代码结构、查找函数或探索代码库时触发。它会用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold 替代直接读文件。

say.text: 帮我搜一下 src 里 shutdown 相关的代码
say.note: 触发 smart_search,返回匹配符号和文件概览

say.text: 列出 worker-service.ts 这个文件的结构
say.note: 触发 smart_outline,显示所有函数和类

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude changes how it explores code: instead of reading whole files, it builds a structural map first. It uses smart_search to find relevant files and symbols, smart_outline to view file skeletons, and smart_unfold to expand only the needed function source, saving tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase. It replaces direct file reading with smart_search, smart_outline, and smart_unfold.

say_en.text: Find code related to shutdown in src
say_en.note: Triggers smart_search, returning matching symbols and file overviews
Triggers smart_outline, showing all functions and classes
Triggers smart_unfold, showing full source of the function
